== Biography ==

The King of Hearts is the judge presiding over the trial of the Knave of Hearts. He is seated upon a throne with the Queen of Hearts, wearing both a crown and a wig—an arrangement that appears, by Alice's account, neither comfortable nor becoming. When attending to matters of his court, he dons spectacles to examine those who come before him.

The King is exacting in his regard for courtroom procedure. He speaks in a grave voice and insists, with great emphasis, that all jury members return to their proper places before the trial can proceed, repeating this requirement as he looks intently at those in his court. He questions those who appear before him directly, seeking their knowledge of the matters at hand.

== Relationships ==

'''[[Queen]]''' — family. The King reigns alongside the Queen of Hearts, seated upon their shared throne as co-sovereign of Wonderland.

'''[[Knave]]''' — authority. The Knave of Hearts stands trial before the King, who presides as judge over the proceedings.

'''[[Alice]]''' — acquaintance. The King questions Alice as a witness during the trial, examining her knowledge of the alleged theft.

'''[[White Rabbit]]''' — employment. The White Rabbit attends the King during court proceedings, carrying official regalia and serving in an official capacity within the court.
